gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-kufam: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label stamps each letter out alone, its c opening like pincers. Kufam follows in a clean sans, one tube-like width throughout, so the heading's weight has room to lead.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-lexend: Impact Label hits hard, a heavy display face with a high x-height and thick-thin contrast. Lexend's open, outsized sans lowercase keeps going quietly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-mozilla-headl: Impact Label stamps out heavy, commanding letters, each one standing alone like a bead on a rod. Mozilla Headline fills in beneath with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, friendly where the heading is blunt.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-mozilla-text: Blunt, heavy and sure of itself, Impact Label sets each letter apart like a bead on a rod. Shrink it, though, and Mozilla Text's tall plain sans lowercase takes over.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-nata-sans: Impact Label is heavy and commanding, with a high-set x-height and every letter standing alone like a bead. Nata Sans does the quiet work, with open curves in flat linework.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-nobile: Loud, blocky letters take the lead here. Impact Label sets the tone, while Nobile's open-mouthed sans-serif lowercase, with almost no gap between x-height and caps, keeps a long stretch of text moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans: Commanding from the first letter, Impact Label is built for the big, heavy statement. Noto Sans does the opposite job, its lowercase filling most of the letter height and its wide-open c keeping body text easy to follow.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-adl: Clean curve endings, kept well apart, give the body its easy look, with c, s and z standing tall and full. Noto Sans Adlam would carry a long passage without fuss, while Impact Label stays heavy up top.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-ana: Heavy and bold on top, Impact Label stands each commanding letter apart like a bead on a rod. Then Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs takes over, its outward-pointing terminals and tall x-height making lines of text run along smoothly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-bat: Noto Sans Batak towers with a stubby, pencil-like x-height and a wide-open e that never looks squeezed. Paragraphs feel sturdy and approachable beneath Impact Label's heavy hand.
